cases.title: Freelance Producer/News Editor
cases.text: OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY Fox News Media FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month. JOB DESCRIPTION We have an exciting opportunity for a freelance Producer/News Editor for our network radio news operations (terrestrial and Fox News Headlines 24/7 - Channel 115 on SiriusXM Radio). As the Producer/News Editor you are our editorial leader, working with news anchors to craft the content and structure of a 24/7 news operation. This is fast moving news environment! Your ability to thrive in a fast-paced deadline-driven newsroom allows you to deliver top quality rundowns/segments/newscasts. You excel at multi-tasking and pay close attention to details. Your writing and editing skills are excellent and your editorial judgment is first-rate. Shifts: Weekend mornings, afternoons, overnights – plus opportunities to fill in during weekday shifts. A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Format, program, coordinate, and produce a live news program Produce segments/rundowns and reporter hits Manage and keep clear communication with Reporters, Editors, Assignment desk and Anchors Keep newscast updated by working on developing stories as day progresses Handle staffing issues when managers are not present Check segments and newscasts for editorial accuracy/updates WHAT YOU WILL NEED Experience editing all-news radio or producing live breaking news in a television control room Highly skilled in writing and copy editing Ability to handle breaking News situations Strong editorial judgment is a must Ability to interact with high profile talent A positive attitude and great communication skills Ability to work well with a team environment Ability to multi-task in a fast paced work environment Knowledge of iNews, ENCO and Adobe Audition (Cool-Edit) a major plus #LI-AA1 We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law. Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $28.00-37.50 per hour.

cases.title: Line Producer, America's Newsroom
cases.text: OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY Fox News Media FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month. JOB DESCRIPTION America’s Newsroom is looking for a sharp, creative, and highly motivated Line Producer to oversee the live production of the program’s 10 AM hour. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, breaking news environment, exercises strong editorial judgment, and understands how to create compelling television. The Line Producer is more than an executor—they are a key contributor to the editorial process who consistently generates ideas, identifies opportunities, and helps shape the day’s coverage. We are looking for someone who is curious, collaborative, and eager to grow into expanded editorial and leadership responsibilities. A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Build, maintain, and execute the rundown for the 10 AM hour Manage live control room production and make real-time editorial decisions during breaking news Collaborate with senior producers, bookers, and associate producers to develop daily coverage Identify strong video, soundbites, graphics, and visual storytelling opportunities Produce guest segments, reporter hits, anchor discussions, and breaking news coverage Copy edit scripts, banners, and graphics to ensure accuracy, clarity, and strong storytelling Monitor multiple news sources and flag important developments throughout the day Participate in editorial meetings and contribute original story ideas and segment concepts Communicate clearly and effectively with talent, directors, and technical staff during live broadcasts Assist with social media and cross-platform content initiatives as needed Help mentor junior producers and contribute to a collaborative team environment WHAT YOU WILL NEED Bachelor’s degree in journalism or related field of study is preferred, or equivalent experience Prior television and live control room experience Proven ability to make sound editorial decisions independently in a fast-paced news environment Strong news judgment and passion for breaking news, politics, and current events Excellent writing, copy editing, and communication skills Ability to remain calm and decisive under deadline pressure Strong organizational skills and attention to detail Familiarity with iNews, Dalet, VIZ, and newsroom production workflows Ability to identify compelling elements that elevate television storytelling Demonstrated curiosity about emerging technologies, audience trends, and new workflows that can enhance storytelling and newsroom efficiency Desire to grow into larger editorial and leadership responsibilities #LI-KC1 We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law. Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $83,000.00-110,000.00 annually. This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. cases.text: OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY Fox News Media FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month. JOB DESCRIPTION Fox News is looking for a CRM Specialist to implement and analyze customer communications across all channels: email, push notifications, and In-App Messages. In this role, you will leverage Braze, an email service provider (ESP) to create and execute marketing campaigns. This Marketing Specialist will collaborate with Editorial, Creative, Product, and Business Intelligence to ensure customer journeys are accurate and deliver optimal user experiences. We're seeking a tech-savvy marketing enthusiast who is detail-oriented, an excellent proofreader, and thrives in fast-paced environments. Help us drive impactful campaigns for Fox News! A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Campaign Creation: Create, Q&A, and execute marketing campaigns across all channels including: email, push notifications, desktop notifications, and in-app messaging Digital Campaigns: Assist with the coordination and trafficking of display and video assets across owned and operated platforms, supporting both internal and external initiatives Creative Execution: Update and optimize marketing assets to ensure they render cleanly and look polished across email and in-app messaging, applying visual edits and final refinements in tools like Photoshop, Figma, or similar platforms Writing & Communication Excellence: Put your strong spelling, grammar, and copywriting skills to work. Review and refine marketing copy to make sure every message is polished, engaging, and on-brand Data Analysis & Reporting: Monitor campaign performance metrics (e.g., CTR, open rates, conversion rates) and provide actionable insights for continuous improvement Optimization: Conduct A/B testing to enhance campaign performance and improve customer engagement Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with Editorial, Creative, Product, and Business Intelligence, maintaining clear communication to support execution and alignment WHAT YOU WILL NEED Experience in marketing or related field Excellent spelling, grammar, and communication skills Strong attention to detail and QA discipline in campaign execution Brings a positive, proactive approach to working across all teams Ability to prioritize and work in a fast paced environment with changing priorities Proficient in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, Box, Zoom #LI-AA1 We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law. Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $26.00-31.00 per hour.

You love breaking news and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You have breaking news reporting experience and understand the issues and stories that resonate with the Fox News audience. You’re building a rolodex of networks across America from police to politics to pop culture. You are skilled at delivering several stories accurately on a daily basis, mainly covering breaking news along with news of the day/trending news. You will have the opportunity to do original and exclusive reporting. You will be offered the following shift: 8:00 AM ET - 4:00 PM ET, Monday-Friday **This is NOT an on-air role.** A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Cover breaking news events, writing quickly and precisely to help solidify Fox News as the go-to site for breaking news Pitch and cover stories that resonate with FoxNews.com’s audience, aggregating with complete and proper attribution Pursue original and exclusive stories through close contact with sources Conduct and edit original, on-camera video interviews Present all original, breaking, and aggregated stories in an accessible, consistent, and compelling style Collaborate closely with editors and fellow writers/reporters WHAT YOU WILL NEED A Bachelor’s Degree in journalism or a related field of study preferred, or equivalent experience Newsroom experience Ability to work holidays, extra days, and longer hours and possess an “on-call” mentality Ability to work in emergency and/or breaking news conditions Ability to travel domestically and internationally when breaking news warrants Ability to deliver accurate copy under pressure in a deadline-driven environment Firm grasp of current news and events Strong understanding of the FoxNews.com audience Firm grasp of SEO story production and content development Knowledge of AP style Experience with PhotoShop and knowledge of video (iPhone) editing skills preferred Ability to leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, NotebookLM)) to accelerate research, fact-gathering, and story framing in a fast-moving news cycle. #LI-BC1 We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. cases.title: Marketing Manager, FOX News Media
cases.text: OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY Fox News Media FOX News Media operates the FOX News Channel (FNC), FOX Business Network (FBN), FOX News Digital, FOX News Audio, FOX News Books, the direct-to-consumer digital streaming services FOX Nation and FOX News International and the newly announced platform FOX Weather. Currently the number one network in all of cable, FNC has also been the most watched television news channel for 20 consecutive years, while FBN currently ranks among the top business channels on cable. Owned by FOX Corporation, FOX News Media reaches 200 million people each month. JOB DESCRIPTION FOX News Media is seeking a strategic and results-driven CRM Marketing Manager to lead customer lifecycle marketing initiatives across our portfolio of digital products. This role will be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing multi-channel CRM campaigns that deepen audience engagement, increase subscriber acquisition and retention, and drive long-term customer value. The ideal candidate is equal parts marketer, strategist, and technologist, with deep experience in marketing automation, customer segmentation, personalization, and campaign analytics. You'll work cross-functionally with Product, Editorial, Growth, Data, Analytics, Design, and Engineering teams to deliver timely, personalized customer experiences at scale. A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES Develop and execute lifecycle marketing strategies across the customer journey, including acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, win-back, and loyalty. Build and manage multi-channel CRM campaigns utilizing email, push notifications, in-app messaging, and other owned channels. Own campaign planning, audience segmentation, journey orchestration, QA, deployment, and post-campaign analysis. Design and optimize automated customer journeys that improve engagement and conversion metrics. Partner closely with Product, Analytics, and Data Engineering teams to leverage customer insights and behavioral data for personalization. Create and maintain customer segmentation frameworks using demographic, behavioral, and first-party data. Lead A/B and multivariate testing initiatives to continuously improve campaign performance and customer experience. Monitor key CRM KPIs including open rate, click-through rate, conversion, retention, churn reduction, and customer lifetime value. Develop dashboards and executive reporting to communicate campaign performance and strategic recommendations. Ensure CRM campaigns align with brand standards, editorial priorities, legal requirements, and privacy regulations. Stay current on CRM best practices, emerging technologies, and evolving consumer engagement trends. Experience leveraging Braze to create personalized, data-driven customer experiences at scale is highly preferred WHAT YOU WILL NEED Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field. CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing experience. hands-on experience with Braze or a comparable enterprise marketing automation platform. Experience managing complex, multi-channel customer journeys. Strong understanding of customer segmentation, personalization, and lifecycle strategy. Experience interpreting campaign performance data and translating insights into optimization strategies. Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams. #LI-AA1 We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $83,000.00-89,000.00 annually. This role is also eligible for various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. cases.title: DGA Associate Director - perdiem position
cases.text: OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY Fox TV Stations FOX Television Stations owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations in the U.S. These include stations located in 14 of the top 15 largest designated market areas, or DMAs, and duopolies in 11 DMAs, including the three largest DMAs (New York, Los Angeles and Chicago). Of these stations, 18 are affiliated with the FOX Network. In addition to distributing sports, entertainment and syndicated content, our television stations collectively produce approximately 1,200 hours of local news every week. These stations leverage viewer, distributor and advertiser demand for the FOX Network’s national content. JOB DESCRIPTION Candidate must be able to direct high content, fast paced local newscast, coordinate technical requirements of newscast with news and Engineering/Production departments to ensure a clean broadcast; assist News Producer as necessary with all technical aspects of newscast; additional duties include directing specials and other programming as assigned by the Engineering/Production department. Must have both manual and ELC directing/coding experience. Individual must have at least 10 years major market directing experience at a commercial broadcast station or production facility in the above capacity, with an emphasis on News; ability to work well as a team player in a pressure filled environment; must be able to work flexible hours/weekends/night/early morning/holidays. Candidate will also be required to join the DGA union. Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience and in accordance with the applicable union collective bargaining agreement is: $54.43 per hour. We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law. Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $54.43 per hour.
